record.question: The probability that an ordinary year has 53 Sundays is
record.explanation: An ordinary year has 365 days=52 full weeks plus one extra day. It has 53 Sundays precisely when the extra day is Sunday; under the usual equal-weekday model the probability is 1/7, option B. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
